svg.text: runs as-is; the SSD1306 init differs slightly from SSD1309.

svg.text: I2C is new, on GPIO5 / GPIO3, clear of strapping pins 8 and 9.

svg.text: SPI on the 938: cut its two jumpers and solder the header.

svg.text: GPIO2 (RST) is a strapping pin: if boot misbehaves,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: move RST to GPIO0 or tie the OLED's Rst high.

svg.text: Solder the 4755's charge jumper to 500 mA: the default 1 A is 2C for a 500 mAh cell.

svg.text: Charger LOAD goes to the Beetle's VIN pin only, never to 3V3 or BAT.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The Beetle has its own LiPo charger; leave its BAT pin open in this kit.
